title: A GitHub project kept in step by tools/project.sh

number.description: The project's number in the organization

scope.description: Labels whose issues belong here: an open issue with one of them, or with "<label>: <area>", is added, and an issue with none is taken off. Leave it out for every open issue.

field.description: A single select set from each issue's labels, with an option per label.

prefix.description: Options are the labels that start with this, without it ("locallibrary: " gives cli, core and so on). Without it, options are the tools' labels.

other.description: An option for issues with none of the labels, set only while the field is empty.

fields.description: Visible fields, by name. Roadmaps can't have them.
